headline:

woven together.
subheadline: Reviewed ecommerce agent traces for AI evaluation and training.
footer: EARLY PILOT / SCOPED WITH YOUR TEAM
audience: Teams building ecommerce agents for returns, exchanges, refunds and order problems.
objective: Help a prospective buyer inspect the format and identify a specific gap in its own cases.
deliverables: Website hero, landscape social card, square social card and an editable creative brief.
proof: Use fictional examples with visible labels. Scope availability and acceptance criteria with the team.
guardrail: No customer logos, guaranteed earnings or measured training improvement without evidence.
